info.name: Atlas Local (MockProvider)
info.description:
Test the local Atlas stack with zero API spend — every chat/embeddings call uses the gateway's built-in MockProvider (model id `mock`).

**Setup** — pick one:
- Standalone gateway on :8000 (matches the default `baseUrl`): `cd atlas-gateway && docker build -t atlas-gateway . && docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 atlas-gateway`
- Full stack: `cd atlas-infra && make local-up` → gateway is on **http://localhost:8090** (set `baseUrl` accordingly), agent-runtime on :8083.

**Auth**: every gateway request sends `Authorization: Bearer {{apiKey}}`. Valid keys come from the gateway's `ATLAS_API_KEYS` env (JSON list); the dev default is `dev-key`.

variable.description: Gateway origin. Standalone docker run → :8000. Full compose stack (make local-up) → http://localhost:8090.
Agent-runtime origin (compose stack maps it to host :8083).
Gateway API key — dev default from ATLAS_API_KEYS.

item.name: Bulletproof trio
item.description: Three requests that prove the platform end-to-end with zero spend: the routing surface → a real call through the whole request path → the cost trail.

request.description: Proves the **routing surface**: auth works (401 without the bearer key) and the model list includes `mock` (MockProvider) plus the Atlas aliases (`smart`, `deep`, `fast`, `balanced`, `embed`) and any locally wired Ollama models. Expect 200.

Proves a **real call through the whole platform** — auth → ChatService (rate-limit/cache/guardrails when wired) → provider — with zero spend. MockProvider echoes the last user message: expect 200 with `choices[0].message.content` = `[mock:mock] echo: What does GDPR Article 6 require?` and a populated `usage` block.

query.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to the 1st of the current month.

request.description: Proves the **cost trail**: per-app/model token + cost aggregates from the gateway's `call_records` table. Expect 200 with `{since, rows}` when the gateway has `ATLAS_DB_URL` configured (the compose stack wires it to the bundled Postgres; rows stay empty until the accounting recorder is wired into the request path). Without `ATLAS_DB_URL` (e.g. the standalone :8000 container) this returns **503 "usage data unavailable: DB not configured"** — config-gated by design, not a failure.

item.name: Riskier — test first
item.description: Useful but with more moving parts — verify these before relying on them in demos.

request.description: MockProvider implements `embed()` too — expect 200 with one 8-dimensional vector in `data[0].embedding` (zero spend). `input` also accepts a list of strings. Real embedding aliases (`embed` → OpenAI) require a provider key.

Same endpoint with `stream: true` → Server-Sent Events: a role chunk, content delta chunks, a final chunk with `finish_reason` + `usage`, then `data: [DONE]`. Postman shows the raw event stream in the response body (it won't pretty-print SSE) — that's expected.

Liveness of the agent-runtime FastAPI surface (no auth). Expect 200 `{"status":"ok"}`. The agent-runtime realistically only runs via the compose stack (host :8083) — it needs the gateway and Postgres reachable by service name.

Triggers a bounded agent run (hard caps on iterations/tokens/wall-time). Expect **201** with `{run_id, status, iterations, tokens_used, content, ...}`; follow up with `GET {{agentUrl}}/v1/agent/runs/<run_id>` for the persisted steps.

**Dependencies — test before relying on it:** the agent container must reach the gateway (compose wires it), and the bundled spec's `model_alias` is `gpt-oss:120b-cloud` (local Ollama — free, but requires Ollama running on the host; edit `atlas-agent-runtime/agents/regdoc-qa.yaml` to `mock` for a fully offline run). The full RAG/citation path additionally depends on MCP doc-search/citations + Qdrant/Elasticsearch + an ingested corpus, so citation-grounded answers may error or refuse locally. Persistence (non-null `run_id` + the GET endpoint) needs the compose Postgres; 404 = unknown agent name, 422 = a hard cap was breached.
